hook: You premoved a recapture. Your opponent played an in-between check. Familiar pain?
text: You premoved a recapture. Your opponent played an in-between check. Familiar pain? The German masters named it a century ago: Zwischenzug (the in-between move). In 3-minute blitz, 80% of lost pieces come from assuming the opponent will play the expected move. Before you snatch a bishop back, ask: Does my opponent have a forcing check first? If they do, your premove just gave away a rook. Train your eye to spot intermediate moves before your opponent spots them for you.
